# COR090 `missing-exit-or-cycle-label`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An `exit` or `cycle` inside a named DO loop does not name the loop.

## Why

A loop was given a name to make control flow explicit; a bare `exit`/`cycle` inside it refers to
the innermost loop, which is that loop today but silently changes when an inner loop is added.
Write `exit name` / `cycle name`.

## Reported

```fortran
cells: do i = 1, n
  if (done(i)) cycle
end do cells
```

## Preferred

```fortran
cells: do i = 1, n
  if (done(i)) cycle cells
end do cells
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR090] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR090` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `C141` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
